authoringPhases.name: Existing electrical model refinement
authoringPhases.scope: Switchgear, transformers, MCCs, ATS, UPS, generators; verify existing 12 candidate model families against source and improve visual quality

authoringPhases.name: Unmapped electrical components
authoringPhases.scope: 26 explicit electrical class keys lacking direct model defaults on baseline main; first wave tackles eight

authoringPhases.name: OEM-specific variants
authoringPhases.scope: Source exact manufacturer SKU and revision, derive dimensions and appearance from licensed manufacturer CAD, datasheets or product elevations

authoringPhases.name: Multidiscipline backlog
authoringPhases.scope: Complete architectural, mechanical, plumbing and fire-protection classes after electrical-first acceptance

qualityRules: Manufacturer and SKU must not be inferred solely from class geometry
Generic/representative dimensions do not authorize field scale, takeoffs or clash decisions
Do not derive Z from model bounding height without an installation datum
Cables and other flexible accessories are not part of rigid cabinet dimension fit
New T1 geometry requires GLB audit, front/side inspection, origin and mount review
Promote to OEM visual matching only after exact product revision and evidence comparison
Preserve user-authored or already-approved GLBs until the replacement passes review
Do not merge red CI or release untested GLBs
